## 3. Analysis of the functional F

In this section, we study the regularity properties of the functional F and derive and analyze its linearization. First, we introduce the underlying function spaces for functions η : S 2 → R and recall some important facts on Sobolev spaces on the sphere.

3.1. Sobolev spaces on the sphere. We denote by L 2 ( S 2 ) the space of square-integrable functions on the sphere equipped with the uniform measure d σ ( x ) = sin( θ ) d ϕ d θ (which is the same as the Hausdorff measure on S 2 up to a constant factor) and we write 〈· , ·〉 for the induced L 2 scalar product.
